posts.title: Linux Lads Interview
posts.description: A few weeks ago Paul and me sat down with the Linux Lads for an hour long interview about Ardour. It's been a long time coming. We initially met the Linux Lads late 2022 at the Ubuntu Summit. Shane, Amolith and me spend the night at the bar in Prague until sunrise for some some in person bug reporting and bug-bounty beers. posts.title: Linux Audio Developers Spotlight
posts.description: I recently had a nice conversation with Amadeus from @linuxaudioplugindevelopment , talking about my involvement with Linux Audio, Ardour and free/libre software. It turns out that I have short answers to long questions, and vice versa. :) You can find the interview with yours truly on the Linux Audio Developers Spotlight page on linuxaudio.dev. news , ardour , linux , audio
